539-728-3821-4679-6821.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-728-3821-4679-6821.description:
Cause Peregrine Drake to become an enchantment using Jump Scare.
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2023-4770-5295-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

728-7084-7705.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

757-3933-4221-5087.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-3933-4221-5087.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Karn's Bastion to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Living Plane, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

1479-5621-7885.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Down in the Valley, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Down in the Valley trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1661-5078-7650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

3490-3641-5231-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-3641-5231-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

5929-6705-7304.description:
Cast Genghis Frog either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Genghis Frog enters, it triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Quina.
When the creature token enters as a Mutant due to Leyline of Transformation, Genghis Frog triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Quina.
Repeat step 3.
5929-6705-7304.notes: Step 3 creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2829-6972-7154.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Arcbound Condor.
When Arcbound Condor dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Condor's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Condor from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

1978-3918-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1978-3918-4002.description:
Activate Trazyn using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct or activate Trazyn using Voltaic Construct's ability by paying {2}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat.

1651-2573-3875-5334-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-2573-3875-5334-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-2573-3875-5334-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Provisioner triggers twice due to Roaming Throne, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1978-5056-5711.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
1978-5056-5711.description:
Cause Fanatic of Rhonas to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Fanatic of Rhonas.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-3789-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1978-3789-4002.description:
Animate Sceptre of Eternal Glory using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat from step 2.

1074-1651-3263-5640.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and King Macar, targeting King Macar.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens  abilities, untapping it and King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling target creature and creating a Gold token.
Repeat.
1074-1651-3263-5640.notes: You can repeat this combo as desired whenever an opponent controls a creature.

1365-1651-4050-6701.easyPrerequisites: You control two nontoken artifact creatures, one of which does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1651-4050-6701.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving two nontoken artifact creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken artifact creatures, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing one of the nontoken artifact creatures that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other artifact creature.
Repeat from step 3 once, instead sacrificing the creature who had counters placed on it in step 6.
Repeat from step 1.

215-4231-4384-6723.description:
Cast Treebeard either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{W} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Treebeard enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating two Food, two Clue and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Food, Clue and Treasure tokens by tapping them, adding {3}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Treebeard from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1350-3499-4010-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton either from your hand or from the command zone by paying at least {4}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and four Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, four Halflings and four Foods by tapping them, adding {6}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-3499-4010-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

5147-6701--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5147-6701--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a persist creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other persist creature.
Resolve the perist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2105-5256-6591--85.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5256-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

997-2281-3175.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

457-712-4222.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to an artifact creature you control.
457-712-4222.description:
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the creature with Freed from the Real attached, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping the creature it is attached to.
Wake Thrasher triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

372-1987-4125.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Shipwreck Dowser exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker.
372-1987-4125.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Shipwreck Dowser and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Shipwreck Dowser trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Shipwreck Dowser and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1339-2584-6092.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2584-6092.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1116-3240-4476-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-4476-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

2034-3470-5478-5552.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten permanents.
2034-3470-5478-5552.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation and untapped due to Spelunking.
When Temple of Cultivation enters the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

1013-2178-5136.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1013-2178-5136.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1558-2740-4231-4321.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Tamiyo's Journal triggers, creating two Food, two Clue, and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1374-2876-4050.notablePrerequisites: Elenda has a power of three or greater.
1374-2876-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {W/B}.
When Elenda dies, its second ability triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Vampire creature tokens equal to Elenda's power.
Cast Elenda from your graveyard by paying {2}{W}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Vampires, adding {2}{W/B}.
When the Vampires die, Elenda's first ability triggers three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

643-876-1729-4696-5048.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Meldweb Strider.
Activate Meldweb Strider by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to any target and three damage to itself.
Meldweb Strider dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Shelob triggers, creating a token copy of Meldweb Strider that is a Food artifact.
Activate the Meldweb Strider token by removing an oil counter from it, causing it to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Repeat.

1636-3685-4497-5043.notablePrerequisites: Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3685-4497-5043.description:
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah, adding seven {R} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Spine of Ish Sah leaves the battlefield, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {7}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
The Faerie enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, destroying target permanent.
Repeat.

1792-2142.notablePrerequisites:
Zephyr Scribe does not have summoning sickness.
You control a noncreature, nonland permanent that can be cast by paying {0}.
1792-2142.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting Zephyr Scribe.
Activate Zephyr Scribe by tapping it, returning the noncreature, nonland permanent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast the noncreature, nonland permanent by paying {0}.
Zephyr Scribe triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

1926-3944-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing itself, adding {B}.
Blood Pet dies, triggering Species Specialist and Mortuary.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Species Specialist trigger, causing you to draw Blood Pet.
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1013-2178-3500.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents attached to the same creature.
The creature does not have summoning sickness.
1013-2178-3500.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any opponent's creature and causing you to gain 1 life.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat.
